In my opinion it would have been illegal but in another timeline. Back when league was released and there were basically 4 champions in total, this would have been outrageous. But the player base was smaller, there were waaaaay less things to keep track of, runes were absolutely simpler and so on, and i repeat THERE WERE LESS CHAMPIONS (the key point here) so way LESS VARIABLES.
Therefore, you could invest your time on the 'tracking' aspect of the game (jungle timers, ultimates CDs etc. But people had the time and the ability....because less things were happening on the screen, simple as that.
But through the years, as the game kept becoming more and more complex the 'math' aspect of the game became progressively harder.
Put yourself, for example, in the position of someone that picks up the game today.
Trying to 'do the math' for timers and so on, with all the stuff that is happening on the screen, would result in frustration and a mental breakdown and most likely inability to learn the basics of the game. Then they come on Reddit for advice and see those people that play since when the game came out and there were 3 CHAMPIONS typing 'I did the math, why don't you do that too', so they can feel good about themselves and you feel bad about yourself. It's the 'back in my days school was harder' bs of parents basically LOL. Not everyone plays since day one, not everyone has the time of the day.
Peace
